verdict.rationale: Portkey has an API reference section that documents the base URL and header-based integration. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A static API reference is an adjacent feature, not the story's capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
